ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: Nobel Prize in Economics winner Arthur Lewis proposed the “dual economy” development model. Economic development is divided into two stages: first, the stage of unlimited labor supply; second, the stage of labor shortage. The intersection connecting the two stages is called the “Lewis turning point.” After the Spring Festival, the phenomenon of “difficulty recruiting workers” appeared in coastal areas and even in major labor-exporting provinces such as Jiangxi and Sichuan. The “Lewis turning point” of China’s economy may have arrived ahead of schedule. <image1> Based on this, what industrial sector is greatly affected by the appearance of the “Lewis turning point”?

In the figure, the labor supply curve AS is relatively flat in the earlier segment, corresponding to the “unlimited supply stage”; after reaching the labeled “Lewis turning point,” it enters the “shortage stage.” At this time, labor supply becomes tight, and the wage level will rise. Then combine this with the question stem: after the Spring Festival, coastal areas and major labor-exporting provinces such as Jiangxi and Sichuan experienced “difficulty recruiting workers,” indicating that labor is shifting from abundance to shortage, and China may be approaching or entering the stage after the Lewis turning point. Among common industrial sectors, toy manufacturing most typically belongs to labor-intensive industry, so it is greatly affected.

raw_record.question_text:
Nobel Prize in Economics winner Arthur Lewis proposed the “dual economy” development model. Economic development is divided into two stages: first, the stage of unlimited labor supply; second, the stage of labor shortage. The intersection connecting the two stages is called the “Lewis turning point.” After the Spring Festival, the phenomenon of “difficulty recruiting workers” appeared in coastal areas and even in major labor-exporting provinces such as Jiangxi and Sichuan. The “Lewis turning point” of China’s economy may have arrived ahead of schedule.

<image1>

Based on this, what industrial sector is greatly affected by the appearance of the “Lewis turning point”?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中以工资水平为纵轴、劳动力数量为横轴，显示劳动需求增加时，经济从“无限供给阶段”经过“刘易斯拐点”进入“短缺阶段”，工资水平将因劳动力短缺而上升。再读取题干：新春后沿海和劳务输出大省都出现“招工难”，说明中国可能进入劳动力短缺阶段。最后运用工业区位知识判断：受劳动力短缺和工资上涨影响最大的应是劳动密集型工业部门，在常见工业部门中玩具制造最符合，因此答案为“玩具制造”。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中纵轴标为工资水平P，横轴标为劳动力数量Q；工业化进程中劳动需求由AD1向AD2、AD3移动。图中劳动力供给曲线AS在前段较平缓，对应“无限供给阶段”，到达标注的“刘易斯拐点”后进入“短缺阶段”，此时劳动力供给趋紧，工资水平会上升。再结合题干：新春后沿海及江西、四川等劳务输出大省出现“招工难”，说明劳动力由充足转向短缺，中国可能接近或进入刘易斯拐点之后的阶段。最后判断工业部门：劳动力短缺和工资上涨对用工量大、对劳动力成本敏感的劳动密集型工业影响最大。常见工业部门中，玩具制造最典型地属于劳动密集型工业，因此受影响较大。

raw_record.original_question:
诺贝尔经济学奖获得者阿瑟·刘易斯提出了“二元经济”发展模式。将经济发展分为两个阶段：一是劳动力无限供给阶段，二是劳动力短缺阶段，联接两个阶段的交点称为“刘易斯拐点”。新春过后，在沿海甚至江西、四川等劳务输出大省也出现“招工难”现象，中国经济的“刘易斯拐点”可能提前到来了。

<image1>

据此，受“刘易斯拐点”出现影响较大的工业部门是什么？
